record: customization inputs that exist TODAY in the experimental pipeline (technical contract, not a design): body from skelBuild(H, prop), material groups per vertex / per capsule, palette overrides per variant. Any long-term solution must support the requirements in HANDOFF.md §H; how is Astra's call.

body.heightM: gk.height × variant.h (simulation keeper height 1.90 m in fixtures; skeleton lengths are fractions of H)
body.proportions: skelBuild prop multipliers {legs, arms, torso, width} on bone lengths / offsets / girth; clips are rotation-only so any proportion plays the same motion
body.note: what depends on metres is documented in gk_motion_library.js (authored pelvis offsets scale with H / 1.90)

meshSource: anim3d/skin_mesh.js skinBuildMesh(skel): procedural loft at the bind pose, linear-blend skinning (4 influences), per-vertex part id; NOT an approved visual target
